What this kernel offers

Source: R/status.R
status.Rd

Probes the running system for every confinement layer the package can use. Nothing is changed: the user-namespace probe runs in a short-lived forked child.

Usage

status()

Value

A list of class lk_status with elements:

os, kernel

Operating system and kernel release.

landlock_abi

Landlock ABI version; 0 when Landlock is not available (older kernel, not built, or disabled at boot).

seccomp, seccomp_filters

Seccomp mode of this process (0 none, 1 strict, 2 filter) and the number of filters installed.

no_new_privs

Whether no_new_privs is already set.

caps

Capability sets of this process as hexadecimal strings.

userns

User namespace limits and whether a child can create one.

cgroup

cgroup version, this process's cgroup and whether it is delegated (writable).

apparmor

Whether AppArmor is enabled and the current profile.

Values that do not apply on this system are NA.

Examples

status()
#> <landlock status> Linux 6.17.0-1022-azure 
#>   Landlock       ABI 7 
#>   seccomp        none 
#>   no_new_privs   no 
#>   capabilities   none effective 
#>   user ns        yes 
#>   cgroup         v2 
#>   AppArmor       enabled, profile unconfined
